_comment: Seed data for the Trend Registry Notion database. Contains verified 2026 micro-aesthetics and color palettes from WGSN, Pantone, Etsy, and design trend forecasters.

aesthetics.name: Sardinecore / Bistro Nostalgia
aesthetics.description: Ornate Mediterranean tinned seafood packaging, Portuguese tile borders, lemons, olive oil cruets, coastal seafood menus, hand-lettered European bistro chalkboards. Appeals to foodie millennials with cosmopolitan taste and apartment-dwellers who romanticize European kitchen culture.

aesthetics.name: Vintage Matchbook / Motel Ephemera
aesthetics.description: Retro matchbook covers, mid-century motel keytags, roadside diner receipts, vintage apothecary labels, cocktail recipes. Mini-compositions arranged in curated gallery grids. Appeals to nostalgia-driven millennials and Gen Z vintage collectors. Best executed as linocut or screen-print aesthetic with intentional imperfection.

aesthetics.name: Neo-Western / Southwestern Heritage
aesthetics.description: Adobe desert landscapes, stylized coyote/quail silhouettes, horseshoe typography, vintage boots with botanical flora, turquoise accents. Shifted away from gaudy festival fringe into subtle, earthy heritage graphics. Appeals to outdoorsy millennials, Southwest residents, and country lifestyle enthusiasts.

aesthetics.name: Playful Maximalism / Circus-Core
aesthetics.description: Bold oversized polka dots, bold circus stripes, checkerboard variations, whimsical naive creatures, Harlequin diamonds. High-dopamine, unapologetically loud. Appeals to Gen Z, creatives, neurodivergent communities, and anyone rejecting corporate minimalism.

aesthetics.name: Soft Stitch / Heritage Craft
aesthetics.description: Digital designs mimicking physical craft — needlepoint patterns, visible embroidery mending, cross-stitch typography, pressed linoleum relief cuts, risograph grain misregistration. Signals handmade authenticity and rejects mass-produced slickness. Appeals to craft enthusiasts, cottagecore communities, and analog culture appreciators.

aesthetics.name: Moody Gothic Botanical
aesthetics.description: Dark poisonous plants, black forest fauna, Scandinavian folk floral symmetry, nocturnal animals (moths, owls, bats) rendered in hand-carved relief styles. Appeals to #whimsigoth, dark academia, occult-curious, and nature-lover-with-edge communities. Best on dark product blanks.
